intel_admin.title: Intelligence administration
intel_admin.subtitle: Every intelligence setting in one place. Each change is recorded with what it was before and what it became.
intel_admin.agents_hint: Switching an agent off stops that agent only. Production, stock, quality and costing carry on; deterministic alerts keep running.
intel_admin.categories_hint: A category switched off raises no external alert. Name the team that owns each.
intel_admin.thresholds_hint: Kept on the scoring page under two-person approval (version {v}).
intel_admin.approvals_hint: Each action keeps its own approval permission. A second approver can be required above an amount.
intel_admin.models_hint: {d} people can deploy or roll back models; {m} can prepare model versions.
intel_admin.areas_hint: Where to watch for weather, transport and other location-based events.
intel_admin.label: Label
intel_admin.priorities_hint: Raise the priority of named suppliers and materials in external risk.
intel_admin.recipients_hint: Who receives intelligence alerts is set in the manufacturing notification rules, with their quiet periods and factory restrictions.
intel_admin.default_recipients: No rule yet: the default recipients for these alerts apply.
intel_admin.retention_hint: How long each kind of record is kept. Eligible counts what a period would remove today; nothing is removed from this page.
intel_admin.ai_hint: The company allowance is the platform's; intelligence can be held to a lower monthly figure.
intel_admin.ai_company: This month {used} of {quota} tokens used across the company.
intel_admin.monthly_tokens: Monthly tokens for intelligence (empty: no extra limit)
intel_admin.narration: Let a language model word computed answers
intel_admin.entitlements_hint: Package {p}. Positioning: {mode}. An entitlement decides whether an area is offered; it never grants a permission.

positioning.enterprise_only: every intelligence area is Enterprise (current behaviour)

intel_admin.escalate_to_hint: e.g. mfg.intel.approve; holders of these permissions receive the escalation
intel_admin.agent_runs_hint: Empty or 0 = no cap. Runs above the cap are reported as LIMITED.
